name: Honey
aliases: honey, blossom honey, nectar honey, honeydew honey, comb honey, filtered honey, baker's honey
what_is: A natural sweet substance produced by honey bees from plant nectar or other plant secretions or excretions that bees collect, transform, dehydrate, store and mature in honeycombs.
why_botia: BOTIA flags honey because it is produced by bees and the sugars naturally present in honey are classified by WHO as free sugars.
can_1: Identify honey and common declared honey types when they appear in the ingredient list.
can_2: Trigger the animal-origin and sugar information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the botanical or geographical origin of the honey unless it is explicitly stated on the label.
cannot_2: Calculate the product's total free-sugar content or predict a health effect from the presence of honey alone.

sources.label: WHO — Guideline: Sugars intake for adults and children

title: Honey
description: A natural sweet substance produced by honey bees; its naturally occurring sugars are classified by WHO as free sugars.
